vector_db_chunks.text: The Ministry of Home Affairs describes the Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C) as a nodal point in India's response to cybercrime. The I4C scheme includes National Cybercrime Reporting, which facilitates reports of all types of cybercrime incidents, routes reports to the concerned State or Union Territory for appropriate action under law, and allows complainants to view the status of action taken. This describes the reporting component's stated role and does not guarantee a particular investigation or outcome.
